Flytower 1.4.2 is a bug-fix and speed update from the same code review as 1.4.1. Scheduled restarts no longer block a backup due during their countdown: the backup runs and the restart waits for it. Stopping the server or changing the task mid-countdown calls the restart off. Live updates no longer arrive twice after the panel reconnects. A stray error can no longer bring the panel down, and the live console follows the log through file events instead of checking it twice a second. The Rust system helper no longer cuts off slow downloads after two minutes.

The Files tab respects view-only access, keeps uploads and edits in the folder they started in, and asks before you leave unsaved changes. Pages that fail to load say so, with **Try again**, instead of looking empty. Signing in takes you back to the page you wanted. Big imports and logs are capped while they unpack, import links can't be redirected to this machine or its network, and off-site backups tidy up after deleted targets and backups. The public map and Discord `/stats` show only the players and figures your status page shows, and one huge map no longer holds up every other one. Activity and job history now trim themselves, and database updates are safe for future table changes.

Re-running the installer now keeps the version you have instead of moving you to the newest stable (add `--version latest` to move on), copies the database before any downgrade, and the firewall keeps SSH open on whatever port it really uses. Releases now wait for the install and upgrade tests to pass. Testing notes are in each pull request of the [1.4.2 milestone](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/milestone/18?closed=1).
